links.outcome: Discrimination of model predictions combined with surgeon responses versus model alone
links.effect: Surgeons disagreed with 53% of predictions; adding surgeon responses raised AUCs from 0.66/0.82/0.83 to 0.68/0.83/0.86, none statistically significant; effects varied across risk quartiles.
links.quote: Incorporating surgeon responses increased AUCs to 0.68, 0.83, and 0.86, respectively; none of these differences were statistically significant.

links.outcome: Discrimination of model predictions with versus without surgeon responses
links.effect: Adding surgeon responses changed AUCs from 0.66 to 0.68 (NSQIP-SRC), 0.82 to 0.83 (POTTER), and 0.83 to 0.86 (MySurgeryRisk); none of these differences were statistically significant.
links.quote: Incorporating surgeon responses increased AUCs to 0.68, 0.83, and 0.86, respectively; none of these differences were statistically significant.
